resource512_delta(before, after, prefix=""):
    """Exact JSON leaf delta, with arrays retained as original whole values."""
    if isinstance(before, dict) and isinstance(after, dict):
        result = []
        for key in sorted(set(before) | set(after)):
            if key not in before or key not in after:
                result.append({"path": prefix + "/" + key, "before": before.get(key), "after": after.get(key)})
            else:
                result.extend(w3_resource512_delta(before[key], after[key], prefix + "/" + key))
        return result
    return [] if type(before) is type(after) and before == after else [
        {"path": prefix, "before": before, "after": after}]
